scope: Commercial insurance submission review across accounts, insured entities, and supported document formats. Account-specific examples in the source register are patterns, not required values or facts for other accounts.
policy: Only report findings that fit one of the issue themes below and are supported by the current submission evidence.
Apply themes to analogous account data; never assume an example discrepancy exists in another account.
Distinguish a confirmed data conflict from an evidence gap, question, or need for human review.
Require matching insured/legal entity, location, vehicle, class, claim, line of business, and relevant period before comparing records.
Missing or incomplete evidence is not proof of an adverse fact, legal violation, fraud, coverage position, or rating error.
Do not duplicate one underlying issue across themes; preserve distinct reconciliation questions when their evidence or corrective action differs.

issues.title: Location count, property schedule, and value conflict
issues.criteria: Conflicting premises counts, location identities, or property values across applications, ACORD 140, SOV, and related schedules for the same submission and locations.
issues.must_not_claim: Do not infer a conflict from different scope, duplicate aliases, or different valuation dates without checking them.

issues.title: Unexplained ACORD 140 version discrepancy
issues.criteria: Two received/resubmitted ACORD 140 versions for the same submission differ materially and no supplied change history explains the revision.
issues.must_not_claim: Version difference alone is not evidence of manipulation or fraud.

issues.title: Workers compensation payroll mismatch
issues.criteria: Application, quote, or rating payroll conflicts with supporting payroll/class schedules after matching policy term, states, locations, and included classes.

issues.title: Workers compensation experience modifier mismatch
issues.criteria: Current-term experience modification factor differs between application/support and quote/rating inputs after distinguishing current from prior term.

issues.title: Claims and loss-history reconciliation exception
issues.criteria: Duplicate or conflicting claim identifiers/details, or claim-level incurred amounts that do not reconcile to stated loss totals for the same loss run.
issues.must_not_claim: Keep annual count and line-of-business history differences separate under N3 unless the same specific loss detail exception is independently evidenced.

issues.title: Declared operations and external context require scope matching
issues.criteria: Submission-described operations conflict with declared operations, or external public context suggests a question that requires matching the named insured, legal entity, scheduled premises, and actual operations.
issues.must_not_claim: Company-wide, subsidiary, or unmatched-premises information does not establish an insured-location exposure.

issues.title: Current driver roster or MVR review evidence missing
issues.criteria: Submission checklist or quote explicitly identifies the current roster, driver-to-vehicle mapping, or MVR review evidence as missing or unvalidated.

issues.title: Declared fleet count differs from scheduled active units
issues.criteria: Declared power-unit count conflicts with count of active scheduled vehicles after checking as-of date, eligibility, vehicle type, and schedule scope.

issues.title: Cargo exposure may exceed quoted limit or stated terms
issues.criteria: Documented peak shipment/cargo values or operations appear inconsistent with quoted cargo limits or stated exclusions, requiring underwriting review.
issues.must_not_claim: Do not make a final legal coverage determination.

issues.title: Workers compensation state allocation conflict or incomplete ACORD 130 schedule
issues.criteria: State/location/class payroll schedules conflict, or the ACORD 130 state/location/class schedule is materially incomplete compared with supporting schedules.
issues.must_not_claim: Incomplete data alone does not establish a state-allocation conflict.

issues.title: Workers compensation employee-count differences
issues.criteria: Full-time or part-time employee counts differ across ACORD forms, workbook, or supporting schedules for aligned location, class, and period.

issues.title: Loss detail does not reconcile to annual claim counts or workers compensation history
issues.criteria: Annual claim counts or line-of-business/year mapping across loss detail, ACORD 126, and ACORD 130 do not reconcile for the same years and scope.
issues.must_not_claim: Do not duplicate M5 duplicate-claim or incurred-total exceptions.

issues.title: General liability sales and area rating bases lack reconciliation
issues.criteria: Declared sales or area basis differs from GL class/exposure rating bases or application/property schedules and lacks a supported allocation/reconciliation.

issues.title: Fleet garaging state conflicts with garaging address
issues.criteria: Vehicle state/territory codes conflict with the same vehicle's stated garaging address after accounting for address, effective date, and territory rules.

issues.title: Heavy-vehicle driver qualification review required
issues.criteria: Heavy vehicle configuration/weight and assigned driver records indicate qualification, license class, or endorsement evidence needs validation, or such evidence is absent.
issues.must_not_claim: Do not assert a violation or specific license mismatch without jurisdiction/configuration-specific evidence.

issues.title: Workers compensation class rates differ between form and workbook
issues.criteria: ACORD 130 class rates differ from WC workbook rates for the same class, state, and term, and authoritative approved rate support is absent or not aligned.
issues.must_not_claim: A difference is a reconciliation item, not proof either rate is incorrect.

issues.title: External OSHA record is not matched to scheduled premises
issues.criteria: An external OSHA/public record is associated with the insured but the establishment identity/address/date has not been matched to a scheduled synthetic/insured premises.
issues.must_not_claim: An unmatched public record is not evidence of a violation at a scheduled location.
